reviews.text: Jeanetta and Spoiled Pooch are great!  And Kristin is the best there is!  She took care of our dog, Baxter, who can be quite difficult, for many years and treated him like her own.  Highly recommend!

I am so relieved to have found such wonderful dog walkers! Anna leaves great updates after her walks with my dog, and always includes tons of cute photos. I appreciate this so much. I cannot say enough good things about Jeanetta and her team. ❤️

We can’t say enough good things about Jeanetta and her team! Crystal and Heather are wonderful with our dog and always make sure her routine stays consistent. They have also been incredibly flexible and helpful when we’ve needed last-minute walks.

Heather has taken care of our dog a few times via the in-home boarding service, and we’ve never had a single worry about our dogs care.

Overall the best dog walking service we’ve ever used, highly recommended!

Jeanetta and her team have been nothing short of amazing. I have a rambunctious golden retriever who one of the team members, Kellie, walks a couple times a week. She is so patient and loving with him. He seems to be picking up some of the training Kellie is doing on their walks, staying calm while seeing other dogs. He is always happy and tired after his walks with Kellie and I know he is always excited to see her.
The communication and transparency are equally phenomenal. Always easy to get in touch with Kellie and the business owner, Jeanetta. They are so accommodating and also share details from every walk--I feel like I am there with them!
Though I only have been using their walking services, they have a tremendous number of options including pack walks and hikes.
My Oliver is going to forever be a Spoiled Pooch.
Thank you, Jeanetta & Kellie.

I cannot sing enough praises for Spoiled Pooch. Jeanetta and Jessica are both lifesavers!! Our dog is a pretty anxious gal and is slow-to-warm with most people. She also has pretty severe separation anxiety and after staying with Jessica a few times, she didn't want to come back home with us! This is the first time that has ever happened! This shows us literally how spoiled and well-cared for she was with Jessica, as she usually cannot wait to hop back in the car to go home.

Jeanetta and her crew at Spoiled Pooch are the very best! The thing I appreciate the most is the transparency; you always know what is going on and when something needs addressed. They are also super responsive! As a dog mom, these are key things for me and Spoiled Pooch delivers every time! Highly recommend!!

My 11 month old puppy had a fabulous time staying at Jessica's! It was his first time away from home without me. She took excellent care of him and provided me with photos and updates. I couldn't have been happier! Spoiled Pooch provides a private portal for viewing and I find the business extremely professional and well run. Highly recommend!

I Loooooove Spoiled Pooch! As a working single mom, I needed a trusted dog walker and dog sitters (living alone and having a dog who is picky about people). Jeanette is amazing and has an incredible crew. Their app is so easy to use. I’ve used them for pack walks, dog training, individual walks, and even overnight pet sitting. Heather has done overnights and Alyssa has worked to help my dog socialize and walk better on leash. The communication is great and my pup is always happy.

I highly recommend Spoiled Pooch! A couple years ago, I needed a dog walker after fracturing my finger. I was concerned, because my GSD Sebastian is reactive with other dogs. He is also a big, strong boy. I contacted Jeanetta and she quickly set up a meet and greet with one of her stellar employees, Bianca. It was a perfect match, and two years later Bianca continues to take Sebastian on daily walks. She takes great care of Sebastian, is very reliable, and knows how to avoid the neighborhood dogs or rein him in when he’s being reactive. Bianca gives me daily reports on their walks and Sebastian is always exhausted and happy when they return!

Spoiled Pooch is the best dog walking and sitting company ever! Beau is a literal dog whisperer. He was able to bring our reactive dog along on group walks without incident and took amazing care of both our pit mix and husky when we needed him either just for an afternoon visit or for when we were traveling. I recently moved out of state and I’m so sad to not have spoiled pooch anymore. We trusted them completely with our pups because we knew they were treated like family. I also appreciated their super easily online booking portal. 10/10 best on the west side!

We have had the best experience with Spoiled Pooch. Specifically, Marion - he is the best and loves our dog so much. I have never been able to trust someone with my rescue dog who has a lot of anxiety and leash issues. Marion is the absolute best and I know she’s safe and happy when she’s with him.
